visual-studio-code.note: Settings are JSON/JSONC files; extensions converge through the code CLI.

raycast.note: CFPreferences plus a generated .rayconfig import artifact.

rectangle.note: Typed settings in the com.knollsoft.Rectangle CFPreferences domain.

obsidian.note: Vault settings and plugins are files under each vault's .obsidian directory.

kitty.note: Primary configuration is a user-owned kitty.conf file.

hammerspoon.note: Automation configuration is user-owned Lua under ~/.hammerspoon.

wezterm.note: Configuration is user-owned Lua in ~/.wezterm.lua or XDG config.

alacritty.note: Configuration is user-owned TOML under XDG config.

iterm2.note: A dedicated JSON dynamic-profile file is safe to own; the global preference domains remain outside the recipe.

maccy.note: A typed allowlist in org.p0deje.Maccy owns UI preferences while clipboard content and privacy lists remain unowned.

vscodium.note: VS Code-compatible settings files plus a CLI-managed extension set.

sublime-text.note: Preferences, keymaps, and packages are files under Application Support/Sublime Text.

emacs-app.note: Configuration is user-owned Emacs Lisp in ~/.emacs.d or ~/.config/emacs.
